name: [🧟SOON] Break a Brainrot Egg!
desc:
🥚Break Lucky Eggs and Blocks for Brainrots! 🧊

1. Break Eggs to hatch rare Brainrots! ⛏️
2. Bring them back to your base to earn cash! 💰
3. Level up your Brainrots to make more money! 📈
4. Rebirth for new gear! 💣

😌 No Sammy chasing you - play stress-free! 😌
👀 Admin Abuse is HERE! 👀

💵 2x CASH EVENT - every SUNDAY -> Monday! 💵

⚠️Cheaters and scripters will be detected and banned! ⚠️

If you're having fun, join the group and hit the thumbs up! 👍
